snippet.title: Your Future Self Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1030580/Your_Future_Self/

Your Future Self is a short (1-2 hours) story-driven experimental text adventure with a unique conversational "battle" mechanic. Can you convince your future self they were wrong for a crime they committed in the near future?
